summary: A side-store-free lossless structural ContextView encoding passed exact round-trip and six fail-closed tamper cases in a synthetic F2-style E4 harness. Byte reduction was negative for a one-item view, +20.1% at four items, and about +32-36% at 16-256 items. No pinned target tokenizer or actual production model-facing renderer trace was available, so the result remains E4 research evidence only and is not an E5 Trigger-4 build candidate.
next_discriminator: Measure the same bypass-vs-codec comparison on real admitted F2 ContextViews at the actual model-facing renderer with exact tokenizer identity and downstream behavioral equivalence before any E5 promotion.
